outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot; check not applicable.
Panel B is a micrograph (H&E staining), not a plot; check not applicable.

Panel C shows a box plot of total polyp number per mouse and a 3D bar chart of polyp counts by diameter category, both aggregated across n=8-18 mice per genotype. The box plot itself displays distribution (median/quartiles/range) which is acceptable, but the 3D bar chart shows only mean/aggregate bar heights per genotype and diameter bin without any overlaid individual data points, so the bar chart portion fails the check.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot type), which is exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.
Panel E includes a bar chart quantifying GTP-bound Rac1 and Cdc42 relative to total, shown as bars with error bars but without individual data points overlaid.
Panel F is immunohistochemical micrograph images, not a plot; check not applicable.
Panel G includes a bar chart (bottom left) quantifying relative expression of Asef, pJNK1, and MMP9 with error bars, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
